company.name: Contoso
company.tagline: Trusted digital services, engineered for what comes next.

hero.title: We build and run the digital services people rely on every day.
hero.lead: For more than 25 years Contoso has helped banks, public agencies and fast-growing businesses design, secure and operate technology that simply works.

services.name: Cloud & Platform Engineering
services.summary: Landing zones, internal developer platforms and modernisation of the workloads that run your business.

services.name: Data & AI
services.summary: From governed data platforms to AI agents in production, with responsible AI built into every release.

services.name: Cybersecurity
services.summary: Security built in, not bolted on: secure software supply chains, identity and round-the-clock monitoring.

services.name: Digital Products
services.summary: Customer-facing web and mobile products, designed with real users and shipped continuously.

services.name: Managed Services
services.summary: We run what we build, and what you already have, with clear service levels and transparent reporting.

mission: Help organisations deliver digital services that are secure, reliable and a pleasure to use.
vision: A region where every citizen and customer can trust the digital services they depend on.

values.name: Integrity first
values.text: We say what we will do, do what we say, and are open about risks.

values.name: Customers at the centre
values.text: Every decision starts with the people who use the services we build.

values.name: Craft and curiosity
values.text: We keep learning, automate the toil and take pride in quality work.

values.name: Sustainable by design
values.text: Efficient architectures, lower emissions and long-term partnerships.

milestones.text: Founded in Jakarta as a three-person software studio.
Opened the Singapore office and signed the first regional banking client.
Launched 24/7 managed services and a security operations centre.
Became a cloud-native consultancy with 500 engineers.
Adopted an agent-native engineering system across every delivery team.

engagement.name: Discover
engagement.text: Workshops with your teams to agree outcomes, risks and a realistic plan.

engagement.name: Design
engagement.text: Architecture, security and user experience designed together, then validated.

engagement.name: Deliver
engagement.text: Small, frequent releases with automated testing and security checks.

engagement.name: Run
engagement.text: Reliable operations, clear service levels and continuous improvement.
